title: Bangladeshi Catering in East London: What to Order and How to Collect
excerpt: Plan your Bonna’s order with Bengali dishes for family gatherings and events. Halal, home-cooked food; collection from E2 0RB with at least two days’ notice.
body:
Bonna’s prepares home-cooked Bangladeshi food for family meals and celebrations in East London. Everything is 100% halal and cooked fresh to order. Orders are collection only from E2 0RB: please pre-order at least two days ahead.

Choosing your dishes

For a Bengali celebration meal, explore polao with Bangla-style chicken roast, korma or a Biya Bari platter. Dum biriyani and tehari are other options to discuss when planning your order. The menu also includes fish curries, daal, bhaji and vorta, so you can choose a combination that suits your gathering.

For snacks and smaller dishes, browse kebabs, chops, chotpoti and fuchka. Dessert options include milk egg pudding, shahi jorda, nawabi shemai and rice pudding. Check the current menu and confirm your chosen dishes with Bonna’s before finalising the order.

Planning food for an event

Bonna’s caters for weddings, aqiqah, walima, gaye holud, milad, Eid, iftar, birthdays and office lunches. When enquiring, share your event date, number of guests and preferred dishes. This helps us discuss the food and quantities for your occasion. Confirm availability and the final price directly rather than assuming that every combination is available for every date.

How to place your order

Browse the menu using the View Our Menu link below, then contact Bonna’s on WhatsApp or email orders@bonnas.co.uk. Include your preferred dishes, quantities or guest count, and collection date. Please mention any dietary requirements or allergies when enquiring so they can be discussed before you order.

Collection and notice

Allow at least two days’ notice. Collection is from E2 0RB, East London, with arrangements confirmed when you place your order. Bonna’s does not offer delivery. Make sure you can collect your food before confirming an order.

Whether you are organising a family meal or a larger celebration, start with the dishes you enjoy and tell us about the occasion. We can then discuss your order and collection arrangements with you.
